Finish lab

One railing, four finishes

The finish is what the light reads first. Pick one to preview how it changes the same piece — then carry it straight into your estimate.

Representative photo · finish preview is illustrative Blackened steel

Blackened steel

Steel is darkened and hand-rubbed so the forging marks stay visible under a deep, near-black surface. The classic choice for landmark stairs and gates.

Character
Matte-dark with subtle variation from piece to piece
Best for
Stair railings, gates, historic and loft interiors
Upkeep
Occasional wax; touch-ups blend in invisibly

From the shop floor

Designed, forged, and installed by one team

With 700+ projects completed, the process stays the same whether the piece is a garden gate or a hotel feature wall: measure it on site, draw it, forge it in Brooklyn, and install it with the same hands that made it.

01Consult & measure

Site visit, measurements, and a conversation about style, finish, and budget.

02Design

Drawings and finish samples for approval before any steel is cut.

03Forge & finish

Fabrication in the Brooklyn shop, then your chosen finish applied by hand.

04Install

Delivery and installation by the fabrication team — fitted, leveled, and detailed on site.
